text:
elena: FYI - batch invoice job bill-2026-03-24-09 produced two invoices for customer 'Orchid Labs' (cust_1123). One invoice (inv_227001X) is $9,800, the other (inv_227001Y) is $8,900. The PDF for inv_227001Y shows no 'Surcharge: Partner SLA 5%'.

acct-bot: automated-runner created inv_227001X and inv_227001Y due to retry on attachment failure.

sam: Confirmed in DB: inv_227001X amount_cents=980000 line_items=[usage:900000,surcharge:50000,tax:30000]; inv_227001Y amount_cents=890000 line_items=[usage:890000]. Looks like surcharge line never attached on Y.

elena: any customer payments captured? need to know if refund required. Notifying support to hold replies.

nora: quick log grep shows billing_worker failed at 03:14:22 with 'timeout writing to invoice_pdf' then retried. The retry code path calls create_invoice() again without reattaching optional surcharge lines when job id != previous run. Suspect job_id guard is skipping attach for retries. File: billing/worker/processor.py:212.

sam: SQL used: ```SELECT id, status, amount_cents, metadata->>'job_run' as job_run, line_items FROM invoices WHERE customer_id='cust_1123' AND created_at > '2026-03-24';```
Result:
- inv_227001X | open | 980000 | job=run-7682 | [{usage:900000,surcharge:50000,tax:30000}]
- inv_227001Y | open | 890000 | job=run-7682-retry | [{usage:890000}]

elena: Ugh. So retry created a second invoice but didn't attach surcharge. Could be a race between pdf generation and line attach.

acct-bot: payment status: inv_227001Y captured=false, inv_227001X captured=false. No captured payments.

nora: Proposed immediate steps: 1) pause exporter for run-7682; 2) mark inv_227001Y as voided with note 'auto duplicate - missing surcharge from retry'; 3) trigger reissue of corrected invoice inv_227001Z with full lines. Will need accounting sign-off for void.

elena: I approve voiding inv_227001Y if there's no payment. Please include SPT-1502 in notes and link customer support ticket.

sam: I'll add a DB note and schedule the void script: ```UPDATE invoices SET status='voided', note='auto duplicate: missing surcharge; see SPT-1502' WHERE id='inv_227001Y';``` to run after 30 minutes so support can confirm.

nora: For long-term fix: make attach_surcharge idempotent (upsert by (invoice_id, surcharge_code)) and add unique constraint on invoice_line (invoice_id, code). Also remove job_run guard that prevents reattachment on retry. I'll open PR and tag eng-runtime for code review.

devops: paused exporter for run-7682 and flagged run in k8s configmap. Created ticket ENG-BILL-933. Hotfix deploy window scheduled 60m.

elena: Drafting customer note: "Hello Orchid Labs - we detected a billing automation issue where a retry created a duplicate invoice missing a partner surcharge. We will void the duplicate and reissue the corrected invoice today. No action required on your side. Apologies for the confusion." Will send once void executed.

sam: double-checking: are other customers affected in same batch? running query for duplicates across batch.

acct-bot: batch scan: 2 other customers had retry-created duplicates but all had surcharge present. Only cust_1123 missing surcharge.

elena: Good. Keep this thread updated and add to month-end audit pack. :thumbsup:
